title: New York-based Qodo, which offers AI agents for code review, testing, and governance, raised a $70M Series B led by Qumra, taking its total funding to $120M (Kate Park/TechCrunch)
summary: Kate Park / TechCrunch: New York-based Qodo, which offers AI agents for code review, testing, and governance, raised a $70M Series B led by Qumra, taking its total funding to $120M — As AI coding tools generate billions of lines of code each month, a new bottleneck is emerging: ensuring that software works as intended.
